In Devlog #003, I dive deep into major system upgrades shaping Grim Pulse: The First Blood.

What’s new in this devlog:

Eavesdropping System Revamp
Conversations are no longer flavor. Listening alters quests, unlocks routes, exposes lies, and reshapes outcomes.

Combat Enhancements for Aelthar
Movement refinements, tighter impact windows, smarter enemy reactions, and combat that demands restraint instead of button-mashing.

Isaac the Covenless, Mini-Boss Overhaul
New combat phases, improved AI behavior, and cinematic pacing that turns this fight into a battle of pressure, positioning, and survival.

Cinematic Integration
Information is earned through proximity, silence, and risk with Eavesdropping, and now other cinematic moments.

Grim Pulse is not a power fantasy.
It is a reckoning.
